frames: First, middle, last D frame, fixed before fitting; diagnostic samples only, no full-window acceptance
hypothesis: Explicit elbow/knee geometric-angle targets and target violation penalties may improve original-domain feasibility; old direction/position objective does not directly constrain joint-angle error; 074 has identical large knee error across conditions despite pose changes, test absolute finite-difference steps near zero coordinate bounds independently.
parameter_basis: Joint angles use the same 5 degree engineering scale. Violation weight3 and 80% target margin are explicit exploratory settings, not validated standards. Absolute angular step1e-5rad is an explicit numerical stability probe, compared at same model/objective.
domain: Original asset ranges; existing subtalar DOFs released within their original ranges, as in saved v2 control; no range expansion
